youtube.title: Why are they called minutes and seconds? #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Say it out loud: minute. Second. You've been speaking Latin every day of your life. Around 150 AD, the astronomer Ptolemy took the Babylonian number sixty and cut each part of the sky into sixty smaller parts, then cut those into sixty again. When his book was translated into Latin, the first cut became pars minuta prima, the first small part, and the second became pars minuta secunda. Full episode on the channel.
